title: Combining tests with AND and OR in products

steps.title: Two tests joined by OR
steps.prompt: OR means a row stays when EITHER test is true.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM products WHERE name = 'Amlou Spread 200g' OR id = 1;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM products.
Add WHERE name = …
Join with OR id = …
Write: SELECT id FROM products WHERE name = 'Amlou Spread 200g' OR id = 1;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM products WHERE name = 'Amlou Spread 200g' OR id = 1;
steps.memory_trick: OR widens the net; AND narrows it.
